presetTip: A preset fills in name, ending, find and replace and the letter case. Your own presets carry a star and follow your account to every device.
savePreset: Save the pattern as a preset
name: Name
regexTip: Find is read as a regular expression. In Replace, $1 and $2 stand for the groups.
withoutTip: The file has no value for {names}. That part stays empty.

N.label: Name
N.tip: The old name without its ending

E.label: Ending
E.tip: The old ending without the dot

C.label: Counter
C.tip: Counts up. [C3] pads with zeros to three digits: 001, 002

D.label: Date
D.tip: Date of the last change as 2026-11-02

P.label: Folder
P.tip: Name of the folder the file lies in

A.label: Date taken
A.tip: Date taken from the EXIF data as 2026-11-02

K.label: Camera
K.tip: Camera model from the EXIF data

I.label: Artist
I.tip: Artist from the tags of a music file

T.label: Title
T.tip: Title from the tags of a music file

R.label: Resolution
R.tip: Width x height of a picture or film, such as 1920x1080

S.label: Season
S.tip: Season from the file name, such as from S01E02. [S2] pads to two digits: 01

F.label: Episode
F.tip: Episode from the file name, such as from S01E02. [F2] pads to two digits: 02

saveTip: You find the pattern under this name in the list of presets.
presetsFailed: The presets could not be saved
exprTip: Read Find as a regular expression, with $1 and $2 for the groups in Replace
tooMany: There are {lines} lines, but {names} names are picked. Every line belongs to exactly one file, please remove {drop}.
tooFew: There are only {lines} lines for {names} names. Every file needs its line, even when its name stays the same.
patternTip: Separate several patterns with spaces. * stands for any number of characters, ? for exactly one.
markingTip: Add keeps what is marked already. Replace lifts the old marks.
